messages:
olivia: TL;DR from postmortem: three rollout incidents all point at feature flags + batch-job collision. proposing a prioritized action list.
raj: agree. want owners + timelines.
olivia: action list: 1) flag registry enrichment (owner, risk, dependencies, allowed_blast) — owner: raj — due in 4d; 2) default holdback curve + per-flag override (0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%) — owner: marcus — 2w; 3) signal tagging (flag_id, rollout_step) + sampling bump for batch windows — owner: marcus + eng-sre — 1w; 4) auto-rollback lattice with blast_radius_cap and min_events guard — owner: sara — prototype in 5d; 5) dependency DAG pre-check + validator — owner: raj — 1w; 6) recurrence/drift detector to surface flags that repeatedly cause incidents — owner: olivia — POC 3w.
marcus: sketch of auto-rollback config snippet: `{"auto_rollback":{"window_s":300,"error_rate_pct":1.5,"min_requests":500,"scope":"flag_id","action":"step_back","blast_radius_cap_pct":10}}`
sara: prototype MUST include a simulator to validate there are no cascading rollbacks across dependent flags; will add a CI job that runs scenarios.
raj: will add `dependencies[]` and `risk_level` to flag schema and open a GH PR. rollout controller will validate DAG and refuse progress when deps unstable.
eng-sre: we can support higher sampling for flagged flows and help tune thresholds; will update tracing runbooks.
lina_pm: PM will create remediation board ticket, add labels `postmortem-action` and `rollout-safety`, and run weekly check-ins.
deploy-bot: [automated] created RF-8808: "rollout flag safety + drift detector" assigned to raj, marcus, sara, olivia. :white_check_mark:
zoe: UI ask: show projected cumulative blast radius per step and warn when it exceeds org policy. overrides must create audit entries.
olivia: also proposal: default canary scheduling should avoid known batch-job windows unless explicitly opted-in. add `preferred_quiet_windows` to flag metadata.
marcus: will add `preferred_quiet_windows` field and controller will attempt to honor it when scheduling steps.
sara: I'll post a short design doc tomorrow and demo the simulator next Tue; attaching sample harness logs to RF-8808.
olivia: thanks everyone. next sync Fri 10am. update RF-8808 if you need to reassign owners. :pray:
